hero.eyebrow: Guided learning, with teacher support when it is needed
hero.title: Learn with clarity.
hero.subtitle: STOA helps students ask questions, receive clear explanations, and get professional teacher support when they need more guidance.
hero.imageTitle: Start with your question. STOA explains the next step and keeps teacher support connected.
hero.imagePrompt: Try: "Why does subtracting 2 from both sides keep the equation balanced?"

flow.title: One clear learning path.
flow.visualText: The learning thread stays in one place, with explanations, teacher support, and parent visibility connected.

steps.title: Ask a question
steps.description: Students begin directly in chat with a homework question or uploaded assignment.

steps.title: Understand the next step
steps.description: The Learning Assistant explains the next step clearly, so the student can keep following the work.

steps.title: Ask a teacher if needed
steps.description: When the answer is not clear enough, a qualified teacher can step into the same thread.

steps.title: Parents follow progress
steps.description: Parents see learning history, reports, and teacher-support records without interrupting study.

practiceEntry.title: Practice Path
practiceEntry.body: Start with short challenges in school topics. Choose a topic, solve one step at a time, and use hints to keep moving when a mistake appears.

signals.title: Short practice lessons
signals.body: Each lesson focuses on a small school-topic skill that can be completed in a short session.

signals.title: Hints before answers
signals.body: A mistake shows a useful hint first, so the student can try the next step independently.

preview.label: Current demo topic
preview.title: A short equation practice path
preview.hint: The lesson shows one challenge at a time. Progress stays visible, and hints guide the next move after a mistake.

outcomes.title: School topics
outcomes.detail: Practice is organized by subject, topic, unit, and lesson.

outcomes.title: Step-by-step work
outcomes.detail: Students answer focused challenges instead of facing a long worksheet.

outcomes.title: Visible progress
outcomes.detail: Completed, current, available, and locked lessons show what to do next.

layers.title: Practice starts learning
layers.detail: A short exercise shows what the student can try independently.

layers.title: Learning Chat explains
layers.detail: The unclear step becomes a focused explanation thread.

layers.title: Teachers unblock
layers.detail: Professional support joins after repeated confusion or a support request.

layers.title: Parents see progress
layers.detail: Reports connect practice, questions, explanations, and support moments.

teacher.visualText: Professional teacher support stays connected to the learning moment.
teacher.title: A teacher can step in without making the student start over.
teacher.body: A teacher sees the conversation, the student question, and the previous explanation. Support happens where confusion appears, so the student does not have to restart.

parents.title: Parents see the pattern, without another dashboard to manage.
parents.body: STOA keeps the student learning path focused while giving parents a calm view of progress, practice areas, and teacher-support moments.

items.title: Recent questions
items.description: See what your child is practicing without interrupting the study session.

items.title: Weekly reports
items.description: Review strengths, practice areas, and next actions from the learning history.

items.title: Support records
items.description: Understand when a teacher was requested and how the request moved forward.

items.title: Built for Swiss schoolwork
items.description: Designed around everyday homework questions, grade level, and family visibility.

items.title: Built for real learning routines
items.description: Clear explanations, parent visibility, support requests, referrals, and admin overview stay connected.

items.title: Ready to grow
items.description: STOA keeps the learning experience clear today while leaving room for future services.

cta.title: Start learning with one clear question.
